preRegistered: squad14-core.mjs header + RULES (24 Oct 2026, before any run) + data/strategy-library.json SQ14-*

spus.note: information (portfolio comparison); SPY is the gate

luck: VARIANTS OF A WINNER: 6 rules tried here (SQ14-PB12M, PB15, PB12P5, PB12H, LEADH4, MTPB), one version each, all chosen after SQ11-PB12 / SQ6-MTUM / SQ13-LEADH were seen; SQ11 itself tried 7 rules and the library holds ~450 ideas. A variant that passes is weaker evidence than an independent idea; read block t against the proof bar, not 2.5.
standard: both halves (signal before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2% cost, better than the average liquid stock bought and sold at the same moments (rule and yardstick capped at +300%, AUD-1), better than the same stock held as long on its other days, > 0 without the 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks, block t >= 2.5, return per year of capital tied up above SPY on the same days -> TRADABLE SMALL; block t >= 4.1 -> PROVEN. PB12P5 / MTPB also as one account (0.4% per side) vs SPY and SPUS per half.

SQ14-PB12M.name: Leader pullback 12% with the MTUM-style (risk-adjusted 6+12 month) leader list (hold 126)
SQ14-PB12M.rule: Leader = MTUM-style: among the 300 largest US companies by point-in-time market value at the prior month end, the up-to-60 with the highest positive combined z of 6- and 12-month momentum (skipping the last month), each divided by the annualised volatility of weekly returns (up to 3 years), MSCI method (squad6-core mtumPick). Signal: the first close >= 12% under the highest close of the last 50 sessions while above the 200-session average. Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 126.

SQ14-PB15.name: Leader pullback 15% (12-1 leaders, hold 126)
SQ14-PB15.rule: Leader = the top 20% by 12-1 month return among the 300 largest by market value at the prior month end (as SQ11-PB12). Signal: the first close >= 15% under the highest close of the last 50 sessions while above the 200-session average. Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 126.

SQ14-PB12P5.name: PB12 as a 5-slot account (max 5 open, 20% each, skip when full; hold 126)
SQ14-PB12P5.rule: The SQ11-PB12 signals (12-1 leaders of the 300 largest; first close 12% under the 50-day high, above the 200-day; hold 126) traded in ONE account: at most 5 open positions, each new one 20% of the account marked at the previous close (bought with the cash there is); a signal while 5 are open or on a stock already held is skipped; signals of the same evening taken by the 12-1 return (highest first). 0.4% cost per buy and per sale. Judged per trade on the trades taken AND as a portfolio vs SPY and SPUS per half (CAGR, max drawdown).

SQ14-PB12H.name: PB12 on Shariah-screened leaders only (SIC screen + debt and cash < 33% of market value; hold 126)
SQ14-PB12H.rule: As SQ11-PB12 (12-1 leaders of the 300 largest; first close 12% under the 50-day high, above the 200-day; hold 126), only on leaders that pass the point-in-time Shariah proxy at the leader month end (squad5-core shariahOk: SEC SIC business screen; debt / market value and cash / market value each < 33% on the latest balance sheet filed before that date). Not the ZAD status; today's candidates carry the owner's ZAD mark.

SQ14-LEADH4.name: Industry leader's first 52-week high -> its non-moving large peers, SIC 4-digit, market-value ranks (hold 63)
SQ14-LEADH4.rule: Universe: the 500 largest by market value at the prior month end. Industry = SEC SIC 4-digit (catch-alls 7389, 6770, 9995, 9999 left out); groups with 4+ members. Leader = the group's largest by market value. Signal at the close of t: the leader closes above the highest close of its previous 252 sessions (240+ present) and did not on any of the 63 sessions before. Followers = the group's ranks 2-4 by market value whose 10-session return is under +2%. Buy them the next open; sell at the close of session 63; one open trade per stock.

SQ14-MTPB.name: MTUM-style book on the 300 largest (May/Nov) + one add on its first 12% pullback (hold to the base exit)
SQ14-MTPB.rule: At the last session of May and November: the MTUM-style book (up-to-60 with the highest positive risk-adjusted 6+12 month z among the 300 largest by market value). BASE: buy each at the next open, sell at the close of session 126. ADD: while a base is open, the name's first close 12% under its 50-day high above its 200-day at a close t with t+1 before the base exit buys a second piece at the open of t+1, sold at the base exit close (one add per base). Judged per trade on base + add trades together. PORTFOLIO: every base and add piece 1/80 of the account (bought with the cash there is), 0.4% per side, vs SPY and SPUS per half.
